shortDescription: Module to interact with rapyuta_io packages

options.name: executables_info
options.description: This option lets the user modify parameters of the executables present in the package manifest depending on the name of the executable. Make sure the name of the executable is present in the package manifest.

options.name: manifest_path
options.description: Required when I('present=true'). The path of the package manifest relative to the playbook. Absolute path of the package manifest can also be given, useful when executing on remote servers. Use the copy module to transfer your manifest files to remote servers when executing on remote servers.

options.name: package_from
options.description: There are 2 methods to get manifests. If I(package_from=manifest_path) then C(manifest_path) option is required. If I(package_from=io_project) then C(source_io_project_info) option is required.

options.name: present
options.description: Whether the package should be present in rapyuta.io.

options.name: source_io_project_info
options.description: Required when I(package_from=io_project). This option will take in the source project information from which the package manifest will be taken to use in this playbook and the auth credentials to access the package in the io project. Either the package name or the package uid to clone from the source project. NOTE Package id takes precedence over package name in cloning if both are specified.

options.name: version
options.description: Use I('auto') to increment the package version upon the existing packages by updating the patch number of the highest versioned package. Use I('max') to check the existence of a package. Use semantical version number to create a package with the specified version. The package number specified in the package manifest json is discarded, so specify the version only in the playbook yaml.
